Subject: Local Telemetry Bridge & control-plane offload for airgapped sites

Hi Jorge / Acme team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — attaching the v3 diagram I referenced (private-vpc-ltb-diagram_v3.png).

High level proposal: for customers with airgapped or heavily restricted egress, we run a small Local Telemetry Bridge (LTB) in-customer that does three things:

- Accepts mTLS streams from private runtime nodes (OTLP + lightweight logs)
- Aggregates KV-cache prewarm signatures and short-lived control-plane deltas, then uploads to a staging-bucket/airgap-transfer node on a scheduled window (SFTP or physical transfer depending on cust)
- Acts as a fallback router for control-plane reads when cloud control-plane is unreachable (read-only cache + policy enforcement)

Why: reduces bursty control-plane chattiness across restricted links, improves cold-starts (prewarm hints), and gives customers a single egress/airgap rendezvous point for compliance.

Questions for ops and network:
1) What are minimal connectivity requirements (ports MTLS, egress host allowlist) we should document for rookies?
2) Does EdgeBridge have an SFTP/physical transfer workflow we recommend for daily artifact export?
3) Any objections to running the LTB on a single small VM (2 vCPU, 4GB) per AZ with HA pair and local persistent disk for metrics buffering?

Next steps: if this approach looks ok we'll finalize the diagram and a canary-checklist for internal staging. I put a draft design in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-LTB-design (diagram + config examples).

Thanks,
Dylan

Thanks Dylan — this is a useful direction. A few operational redlines and clarifying notes from infra: 

- Ports & protocols: require outbound TLS (443) to EdgeBridge staging host for push mode; for pull/airgap we support SFTP (22) to a customer-managed transfer node. OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) should be proxied to the LTB local endpoint only.
- Identity: LTB must use a hardware-backed key or TPM-wrapped private key for any long-lived credentials. We cannot accept plain static tokens in airgapped setups.
- Storage: buffer store should be limited to 10GB by default and rotated daily; retention policy must be configurable.
- Control-plane fallback: it must be strictly read-only and honor model pinning or risk silent drift. No autonomous model rollouts from LTB.

Operational impact: we need a documented rollback path (LTB stop + eviction) and an observability plan (local Prometheus scrape + scrape-expose endpoint for on-site SRE). Marissa — can your team confirm the canary checklist includes the scrape-expose health probes?

I attached a short baseline canary-checklist we use for onprem flighting.

Irene

Looping in ops and a few deployment concerns from my side: 

- Canary windows: prefer 15m health windows for the first two weeks, then 1h windows for ramp. Include a synthetic traffic job that hits model endpoints to validate KV-cache warm behavior.
- Network ACLs: don't assume outbound 443 is allowed; add an alternate of FTPS to a pre-approved bastion. We should publish both flows in docs.
- Cost: LTB will add compute to private deploys; recommend this be an opt-in add-on in pricing and included in Dedicated quotes only if requested.

Also, the LTB should expose a limited admin API reachable only from the customer management VLAN; no API from public internet. Jorge — can EdgeBridge run the staging SFTP host in a cloud tenant that supports 2FA & IP allowlist?

I'll add a line-item to the deployment playbook for pricing and billing.
